data_source: on-chain snapshot (PoolManager + two live v2 pools + their oracles) with PegTracker point history

peg.market_price_source: CoinGecko id f-x-protocol-fxusd (aggregate); peg row for fxUSD in peg_tracker_latest_usd.json
peg.nav_basis: fxUSD is minted at $1 against pool collateral and redeemable for collateral at $1 through PoolManager.redeem() when isRedeemAllowed() — a designed state gate on the Curve EMA (< $0.998), not a holder's floor
peg.premium_discount_basis: signed (market price - fixed $1 par) / fixed $1 par * 100
peg.history_coverage: PegTracker hourly rows since the asset was configured; see the export's own span

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Σ(raw collateral x pool oracle anchor) / Σ(pool debt) across the two live v2 pools, read at block 26179816. Honest arithmetic, poor safety number: the collateral is pledged against LEVERAGED LONG positions, so fxUSD's worst day IS its collateral's worst day (reflexive), and the aggregate hides that 90.0% of debt sits on the custodial WBTC leg at the LOWER ratio. Read the per-pool split.
backing.reflexive_basis: collateral is not idle: it backs xPOSITION leveraged longs on the same asset, so an ETH or BTC drawdown stresses the positions that back fxUSD at the same time

pools.name: wstETH long pool
pools.raw_unit_basis: getTotalRawCollaterals() is 18dp-normalised in the pool's RAW unit; for wstETH that is stETH-equivalent (raw / held wstETH ≈ stEthPerToken), for WBTC it is WBTC. The pool's own oracle prices that same unit, so value = raw x anchor with no external rate applied.

collateral_held.note: collateral is custodied by the PoolManager, not the pool; some may sit in the Aave strategy

pools.name: WBTC long pool
pools.raw_unit_basis: getTotalRawCollaterals() is 18dp-normalised in the pool's RAW unit; for wstETH that is stETH-equivalent (raw / held wstETH ≈ stEthPerToken), for WBTC it is WBTC. The pool's own oracle prices that same unit, so value = raw x anchor with no external rate applied.

collateral_held.note: collateral is custodied by the PoolManager, not the pool; some may sit in the Aave strategy

totals.reconciliation_gap_basis: totalSupply minus Σ pool debt; a constant ~264 fxUSD gap has been present since at least 2026-09-22 and is not attributable to either pool. A GROWING gap means a pool this list does not know about.

backing.total_supply_scope: Ethereum fxUSD 0x085780639CC2cACd35E474e71f4d000e2405d8f6 totalSupply only; no other deployment is enumerated
backing.breakdown_basis: partitions SUPPLY by per-pool DEBT; collateral value does not partition supply and is carried on each pool row instead

stability_pool.basis: fxUSD.balanceOf(fxSP) / totalSupply. The Stability Pool is both the peg defence and the dominant holder; the tradeable float is what remains

asset_specific.snapshot_basis: Backing quantities read at Ethereum block 26179816; peg point observed separately at 2026-10-12T23:15:05Z.
asset_specific.version_note: f(x) v2: wstETH + WBTC long pools under one PoolManager. Published f(x) material describing stETH-only backing is v1 and does not describe this deployment.
